ablation: Description omitted from every rendered/OCR view and both left/right inference tables; immutable source copies retain original description in audit-only provenance

assets.git_policy: .cache excluded; small DEV contact sheet and OCR/recipe metadata retained
assets.regeneration: Pinned source/font/software hashes; renderer checks generated bytes against frozen image hashes

interfaces.identity: record_id remains original source opaque ID; view_id and control_family_id are audit-only manifest fields
interfaces.pooling: Run each view separately against the same right roster and shared no-description candidates; never concatenate repeated record_ids

layout_boundary: DEV and TEST use distinct fixed layout/font families; variation is a designed mechanism control, not natural deployment frequency
limits: Synthetic catalog-observation cards, not receipts or original merchant documents
80 source records yield320 dependent views, not320 independent entities
No counterpart labels or outcome files opened
No paid/model calls or confidence claims

missing_identity_scoring.note: Original source association remains provenance only; price alone does not establish a unique identity

status: Frozen observed-data controls; no model outcomes or linkage scores generated

views.clean_structured: Labeled catalog-observation card; original literal source values
views.compact_degraded: Same compact image downsampled 0.55, blurred radius0.6, rotated hash-selected +/-1.5 degrees, with expansion to avoid clipping
views.compact_reordered: Identical source facts with compact reordered table layout
views.missing_identity: Only original price and generic Catalog observation/Price labels; expected action review for insufficient identity evidence
